Class RouxId

java.lang.Object
org.roux.id.RouxId
public final class RouxId extends Object
The RouxId is the identity of one message, stored as two longs. The high long is the first 64 bits. The low long is the second 64 bits. The message id locates the frame. These two longs stay with the frame when a page moves. The values are kept as longs. This type does not build a UUID object. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxId roux-message-identity.md

    • write

      public void write(MemorySegment segment, long offset)
      The method writes the two longs into a segment. The high long is written at the offset. The low long is written eight bytes later. Both writes use the little-endian layout from RouxLayout.
      Parameters:
      segment - The segment is the destination.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the high long.

    • read

      public static RouxId read(MemorySegment segment, long offset)
      The method reads two longs from a segment. The high long is read at the offset. The low long is read eight bytes later.
      Parameters:
      segment - The segment is the source.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the high long.
      Returns:
      The identity is the two longs that were read.

    • compare

      public static int compare(RouxId a, RouxId b)
      The method compares two identities as unsigned longs. The high longs are compared first. Equal high longs are compared by the low longs.
      Parameters:
      a - The first identity is the left side.
      b - The second identity is the right side.
      Returns:
      The result is negative, zero, or positive.

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object obj)
      The method reports whether another object is the same identity. The same instance returns true. An object that is not a RouxId returns false. Equal high and low longs return true.
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      obj - The object is the value to compare.
      Returns:
      The flag is true when both longs match.

    • hashCode

      public int hashCode()
      The method returns the integer computed from the two longs. The high long is mixed first. The low long is added after that.
      Overrides:
